s1.syndrome_frame: Recurring skin eruptions with vesicles and bullae in a child
salient_findings: Hyperkeratotic plaques with distinct borders and annular appearance
Bullous and vesicular lesions on thighs with scattered facial erosions
key_facts: Normal growth and development for age and sex
Multiple areas of erythema, vesicles, and bullae on face, trunk, and extremities
Skin-punch biopsy revealed hyperkeratosis and bullae formation within the epidermis
Whole-exome sequencing revealed a heterozygous variation c.482T>C (p. L161P) in KRT1
Later developed thickened, brown, corrugated plaques over neck, armpits, wrists, and ankles

raw.syndrome_frame: Recurring skin eruptions with vesicles and bullae in a child
salient_findings: Hyperkeratotic plaques with distinct borders and annular appearance
Bullous and vesicular lesions on thighs with scattered facial erosions
key_facts: Normal growth and development for age and sex
Multiple areas of erythema, vesicles, and bullae on face, trunk, and extremities
Skin-punch biopsy revealed hyperkeratosis and bullae formation within the epidermis
Whole-exome sequencing revealed a heterozygous variation c.482T>C (p. L161P) in KRT1
Later developed thickened, brown, corrugated plaques over neck, armpits, wrists, and ankles

differentials: Keratosis linearis with ichthyosis congenita and sclerosing keratoderma
per_call: Keratosis linearis with ichthyosis congenita and sclerosing keratoderma

shortlist.label: Epidermolytic hyperkeratosis
shortlist.why_kept: Skin-punch biopsy revealed hyperkeratosis and bullae formation within the epidermis, and whole-exome sequencing revealed a heterozygous variation in KRT1

shortlist.label: Epidermolysis bullosa simplex
shortlist.why_kept: Presenting with multiple areas of erythema, vesicles, and bullae on face, trunk, and extremities

shortlist.label: Pachyonychia congenita
shortlist.why_kept: Later developed thickened, brown, corrugated plaques over neck, armpits, wrists, and ankles, along with palmoplantar hyperkeratosis

shortlist.label: Bullous congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma
shortlist.why_kept: Presenting with bullous and vesicular lesions, and later developed hyperkeratotic plaques

shortlist.label: Ichthyosis bullosa of Siemens
shortlist.why_kept: Presenting with recurring skin eruptions and hyperkeratotic plaques, and whole-exome sequencing revealed a heterozygous variation in KRT1

raw.rationale: The presence of hyperkeratosis, distinct vacuolization in the granular and upper spinous layers, and bullae formation within the epidermis on skin-punch biopsy, along with the heterozygous variation c.482T>C (p. L161P) in KRT1 from whole-exome sequencing, are characteristic of epidermolytic hyperkeratosis.

rejected.label: Epidermolysis bullosa simplex
rejected.why: Lack of specific findings related to blistering at the dermo-epidermal junction

rejected.label: Pachyonychia congenita
rejected.why: Primarily involves thickening of nails and palmoplantar keratoderma without the characteristic skin lesions described

rejected.label: Bullous congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma
rejected.why: Typically presents with more widespread erythroderma and less distinct hyperkeratotic plaques

rejected.label: Ichthyosis bullosa of Siemens
rejected.why: Characterized by a specific mutation in the KRT2 gene, not mentioned in the case
